# ssp_sensors (Data Source)

Lists all sensor appliances registered with the SSP platform.

Corresponds to `GET /sensors/appliances`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) List of all registered sensor appliances. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>

### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `algorithm` (String) Cryptographic algorithm used by the sensor certificate (e.g. RSA).
- `description` (String) Sensor description.
- `display_name` (String) Sensor display name.
- `id` (String) Sensor UUID.
- `key_size` (Number) Key size in bits of the sensor certificate.
- `token_id` (String) UUID of the registration token used to register this sensor.
